milestoneContract.title: V6 PKG-T4 PowerShell script safety and artifact verifier differential tests
milestoneContract.objective: Parse every repository PowerShell script with the Windows PowerShell 5.1 parser and enforce script safety rules, and differentially test the two install-time artifact verifiers (verify-artifact.ps1 and verify-artifact.mjs) against the same tampering cases, recording any asymmetry as a finding without touching protected files or any pending package scope.
requirements: [V6-PKG-T4-POWERSHELL-SAFETY-2026-09-29 founderAuthorization.rule] Founder rule 2026-09-29: A blocked/review-pending package blocks ONLY its own dependency lane; implement the next independent eligible package in an isolated branch, validate, checkpoint, commit, prepare the frozen review bundle, mark it REVIEW_PENDING if Codex is unavailable, and continue; never modify a pending package's branch, bundle, clone, evidence or cycle state.
[V6-PKG-T4-POWERSHELL-SAFETY-2026-09-29 founderAuthorization.constraint] Tests and non-protected documentation only; no protected file, no pending package scope, no merge.
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical validation (config/validation.json) passes on the exact reviewed commit on Windows with Node >=24 and npm >=11, and the checkpoint records the measured validation environment.

Every PowerShell script under scripts/ is parsed with the PowerShell 5.1 parser without errors and without Invoke-Expression; the safety rules reject EncodedCommand, DownloadString/DownloadFile, persistent Set-ExecutionPolicy, piping to Invoke-Expression, entry scripts without $ErrorActionPreference="Stop" and web requests outside the allowlist or without disabled redirects.

Both artifact verifiers accept a clean tree and reject content tamper, a missing file, a manifest without the lockfile and an unsafe path; the Node verifier rejects an unlisted file and the PowerShell verifier behaviour for it is recorded honestly as a known asymmetry and an open finding, not as PASS parity.
install.ps1 runs both verifiers before bootstrap; outside Windows the selftest skips honestly; no protected file changes and no existing test, validator or policy is weakened.
mandatoryFailureCases: a PowerShell parse error or Invoke-Expression use accepted
a tampered artifact tree accepted by either verifier in the shared cases
the unlisted-file asymmetry hidden or reported as parity
a protected file or pending package scope changed

steps: Read the reviewed commit's selftest and scripts/ensure-omniroute.ps1 with git show.
In memory, remove only the first occurrence of -MaximumRedirection 0 from ensure-omniroute.ps1, leaving the second request unchanged.
Execute the exact safety-scenario body with readFileSync returning that modified string and the original allowlist and helper set.
Observe that the scenario passes despite the first web request lacking disabled redirects.

previousFindingLedger.expected: The safety rules reject a web request without disabled redirects, including when another request in the same allowed script has the required option.
previousFindingLedger.observed: The check uses src.includes(WEB_ALLOWED[name]) for the entire file. One guarded request satisfies the check for every request in that file. The read-only, in-memory reproduction returned PASS.
previousFindingLedger.blockerReason: The new safety checker does not enforce the frozen acceptance criterion requiring rejection of web requests without disabled redirects.
previousFindingLedger.remediationAcceptance: Check redirect protection for each web-request invocation and add a negative regression case containing one guarded and one unguarded request in an allowlisted script; the latter must fail.

steps: Extract the reviewed commit's runPs and runNode helper definitions into an in-memory evaluation.
Observe that both predicates return true, treating unsuccessful execution as successful rejection.

previousFindingLedger.expected: A tamper case passes only when both verifiers execute and report rejection. Spawn errors, timeouts and signal termination must fail the test or be reported as execution gaps.
previousFindingLedger.observed: Both helpers collapse every result other than status 0 into false. Consequently, negative assertions accept status null with an execution error as evidence of tamper rejection. The initial clean-tree check does not establish successful execution of subsequent invocations.
previousFindingLedger.blockerReason: The differential test can report PASS without either verifier producing a rejection for a required tamper case, violating NO_FAKE_SUCCESS and invalidating the claimed rejection evidence.
previousFindingLedger.remediationAcceptance: Preserve and validate subprocess results before interpreting rejection: execution errors, signals and null exit statuses must fail. Add regression cases proving such outcomes cannot satisfy negative assertions while genuine verifier rejection still passes.
